about_the_game:
Explore and fight through the Acri forest and discover the secret to it's high concentration of magic! Learn new spells and find secrets while adventuring deeper towards the truth.

Acri ushered in a new age of peace between the 5 Covens, It's naturally high mana content made it hallowed ground, For most it seemed like a return to the Evergreen Era- Communication and Collaboration bred by proximity. Isn't it wonderful...

Features

  • 2D Action Platforming

  • Different spells to learn and find

  • 6 Unique Areas to Explore

  • 6+ Boss Fights 

  • Secrets To Discover 

  • A Drastically Harder New Game+

Developer Message

Howdy! I'm Volpanic! I pretty much made everything for the game! Except the backgrounds- check out ricenoodlebrain on instagram they did the amazing background work, Oh and the actual art for all the Steam stuff as well!!! Greenhouse: Schism is a game I've tried to make a few times... In fact I have, this is technically a remake I suppose. Thank you for being interested enough in the game to read through this admittedly meager description, Wishlist it iffen ya want otherwise thanks for stopping by!
